content:
#4 I would actually be mildly against such a thing. One of the nice things about a forum is that all the discussion is recorded in a way that’s easy to find again and link to, and also threaded so that many different discussions can happen at the same time without getting mixed up. In a chat room when multiple discussions happen at once, they all get mixed together and confused, and even if you have a log of the chat it’s hard to go back and read what was discussed.

(Also, I do not need another way to spend time on the Internet. (-: )
